projects.name: Lawrenceburg
projects.quote: On January 15, 2026, Talen entered into a definitive merger agreement with affiliates of ECP to purchase the 1,120 megawatt (“MW”) Lawrenceburg asset located in Indiana, and the 875 MW Waterford and 456 MW Darby assets, both located in Ohio.
